title: Perfect Marinated Chicken Breasts
description: This marinated chicken uses Sprite for great flavor. Breasts marinate in a sweet and savory combination to make a delicious grilled main course.
ingredients: 4 (6 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves

steps.text: Whisk lemon-lime soda, olive oil, soy sauce, and garlic powder in a bowl and pour into a resealable plastic bag. Add chicken breasts, coat with marinade, squeeze out excess air, and seal the bag. Marinate in the refrigerator overnight.
Preheat a grill to medium heat and lightly oil the grate.

Remove chicken from marinade and discard used marinade. Cook chicken breasts on preheated grill until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 7 to 8 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
